title: X-AVDD: Cross-Attentive Audio-Visual Dataset Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.13687v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Audio-visual dataset distillation aims to synthesize a small dataset from a large paired audio-visual dataset, while nearly preserving the training utility for neural networks. Existing approaches such as DM and AVDD face two critical limitations: 1) they are memory-intensive, making them difficult to scale to complex architectures and higher samples-per-class (SPC) settings, and 2) they often fail to preserve strong cross-modal semantic correspondence. To tackle these issues, we propose X-AVDD, a cross-attention-based distillation method that explicitly captures inter-modal relationships during synthesis. By decoupling cross-modal alignment from joint optimization, X-AVDD is substantially more memory-efficient, reducing end-to-end synthesis cost by $\sim 8\times$ GPU-hours, while producing highly aligned synthetic data. translated_title: X-AVDD：基于跨注意力的音视频数据集蒸馏
translated_abstract: 音视频数据集蒸馏旨在从大规模配对的音视频数据集中合成一个小型数据集，同时几乎完整保留其对神经网络的训练效用。现有方法（如DM和AVDD）面临两个关键局限：1）内存消耗大，难以扩展到复杂架构和更高的每类样本数（SPC）设置；2）往往无法保持强跨模态语义对应关系。为解决这些问题，我们提出了X-AVDD，一种基于交叉注意力的蒸馏方法，在合成过程中显式捕获模态间的关系。通过将跨模态对齐与联合优化解耦，X-AVDD在内存效率上显著提升，将端到端合成成本降低了约8倍GPU小时，同时生成高度对齐的合成数据。实验表明，X-AVDD显著优于其他音视频蒸馏方法。在VGGSound这一音视频数据集上……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: X-AVDD提出基于交叉注意力的音视频数据集蒸馏方法，通过将跨模态对齐与联合优化解耦，将端到端合成成本降低约8倍GPU小时，同时生成高度对齐的合成数据并显著优于现有蒸馏方法。
en_tdlr: X-AVDD introduces a cross-attention-based audio-visual dataset distillation method that decouples cross-modal alignment from joint optimization, cutting end-to-end synthesis cost by ~8× GPU-hours while producing highly aligned synthetic data that significantly outperforms existing distillation approaches.
